invalidScenarios.appliesTo: All timing and allocation fault rows in all raw reports
invalidScenarios.cause: The harness reused one InvalidOperationException across Onity, UniTask, operations and samples. Repeated throws accumulated stack trace state and cross-library contamination.
invalidScenarios.requiredCorrection: Create separate fresh exception instances for each input operation in PrepareBatch, outside the measured slice, then rerun both hosts with identical corrected runner/config.

discardedRuns: Initial baseline smoke: benchmark-only assertion checked pending state after fault/cancel input completion; corrected before accepted runs.
Second baseline smoke: exception-heavy cohort had 16 timing batches and was stopped; reduced fault/cancel to two batches while retaining eight samples.
Early baseline timing: overlapped a separate root-checkout Unity test process and was stopped; no timing value retained.
Initial candidate allocation attempt: one Profiler marker was missed within 60 frames; exact-runner retry passed and only the retry was retained.
exitEvidence: Each retained timing and allocation process wrote its expected report, logged OnityTask command-line benchmark completed, and exited. Failed, stopped, or overlapping invocations are listed in discardedRuns and did not contribute accepted results.
limits: Unity Editor/Mono microbenchmarks, not Player/IL2CPP, device frame time, or whole-scene workloads. First candidate timing process followed fresh Library import and had globally slower UniTask controls; the independent warm repeat is the timing comparison.
